title.title: Unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets
title.subtitle: Claim: every simple unitary strongly rational VOA is strongly local and gives a completely rational net

beats.text: Two axioms for chiral conformal field theory: VOAs and conformal nets
Claim: they match for every simple unitary strongly rational VOA
Solid boxes are in Lean; the tensor-category matching is paper-only

achievement.label: Strong-locality conjecture (Carpi–Kawahigashi–Longo–Weiner, 2018)
statement: V \text{ simple, unitary, strongly rational} \Rightarrow V \text{ strongly local}
achievement.context: The conjecture is for every simple unitary VOA; this covers the strongly rational ones

verify.detail: Lean: energy bounds, strong locality and the net. Not the module or tensor results
verify.ourCheck: We compared the Lean scope with the claim; we did not build it

plain: Physicists have two rulebooks for 2D quantum field theories; this claims they describe the same theories

voice.text: Two rulebooks for conformal field theory.
Vertex operator algebras and conformal nets:
two ways to axiomatize chiral conformal field theory. Do they describe the same theories?
Claimed: yes, for every simple, unitary, strongly rational algebra.
